![An approval card showing the change Genos proposes, with Approve, Edit and Reject buttons](/lp/shots/en/approval.webp)

You see exactly what it will create or change. Then approve or reject; many changes can be edited first.

```flow
Ask for a change
Read the card
Approve or reject
```

Changes start on Core. This is about Genos AI, built into the app: an app you connect, such as Claude, writes at once with the access you gave it.
